# R4.5d — hosted provider transports: `anthropic-messages@1` + `openai@1` dialects, live `CredentialPort`, OOP variant

Spec: `docs/tickets/154d_R4.5d__provider-transports-anthropic-openai.md` (seq 154d).
Depends on R4.5c (rustls admission ADR-0365 + `HttpModelTransport::with_tls`) + HUMAN-H6 (`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `OPENAI_API_KEY` provisioned — `provided: yes` only, never values).
Requirement ids: **DF-S1.18-1** (dated progress note — stays OPEN; `probe_profile`/`ProbeSpec` + live-signal arms are R4.5e's) · **BL-31** (hosted-provider `Transport`/`CredentialPort` leg discharged; row stays `open` on R4.5e) · **AC-R-2.3.1-11** (live out-of-process variant — executed) · **AC-R-2.3.1-2** (both families' golden corpora byte-identical) · **R-2.3.3** · **ADR-0364** (one codec) · **ADR-0365** (the TLS legs ride it) · **ADR-0363** (`live-executed` evidence) · **ADR-0366** (this ticket's decisions D1–D4).

## Summary

- **`hh-gateway::anthropic`** — the Messages adapter: request render
  (`messages[]`, top-level `system`, `tools[]{name,description,input_schema}`,
  `tool_choice{type:auto}`, mandatory `max_tokens`); SSE `event:`/`data:`
  translator (`message_start` → stream_start + usage, `content_block_start/delta/stop`,
  `input_json_delta` → `ToolCallDelta`, `thinking_delta` → `ReasoningDelta`,
  `signature_delta` → opaque `ProviderNotice`, `message_delta` → stop + usage,
  `ping` → ignored, `error` → `ModelError`); non-streaming `message` → frames;
  `error.type` error-surface normalization.
- **`hh-gateway::dialects`** — `anthropic-messages@1` + `openai@1` first-class
  `WireDialect` documents (shared chat-completions rule builder; full
  debt-recorded rules per family). ADR-0366 D2: Chat Completions — not the
  Responses API — is the admitted OpenAI surface (corpus-proven translator,
  provider-canonical); D3: `max_tokens` is a required `provider_params` key on
  the Anthropic document.
- **`hh-gateway::credentials`** — `BrokerCredentialPort`: resolves the broker
  `credential_ref` (`env:NAME` → `SecretSource::LaunchEnv`) through
  `SecretSourceResolver` at bind; returns the secret-free
  `CredentialHandle{binding_id: "launch_env:NAME", provided}`; `NoCredentials`
  semantics preserved when no ref is bound.
- **`HttpModelTransport`** — dialect-keyed family dispatch (path
  `messages`/`chat/completions`, accept header, translator pick) + provider auth
  headers attached inside `send` from the handle's `binding_id` (ADR-0366 D4 —
  launch-env resolution at the transport; the value never touches frames,
  handles, ledger rows, or logs): Anthropic `x-api-key` +
  `anthropic-version: 2023-06-01`; OpenAI `Authorization: Bearer`. Unresolvable
  binding ⇒ typed `ModelError{auth}` refusal at send.
- **`hh-embed::gateway_model`** — `ModelLane.credential_ref` member (manifest
  round-trip); dialect-family transcript/body renderers (Anthropic tool carrier
  form: assistant `tool_use` blocks + user `tool_result` blocks);
  `credential_binding_id` on `model.call.requested` = the broker binding id
  (was the hardcoded `credentials:none`); `max_tokens` admitted as a
  `provider_params` member (`required_keys` on the Anthropic doc enforces
  presence).
- **`hh-gateway-stub`** — request member `transport: "live"` binds
  `HttpModelTransport` + `BrokerCredentialPort` in the OOP slot (the suite is
  unchanged — AC-R-2.3.1-11); absent ⇒ the C0 fake path byte-identical.

## Deviation — size budget (orchestrator ruling, verbatim)

> ≈4,550 product+test changed lines vs 900 (≈5×) — **accepted as recorded
> Deviation**: two provider dialect documents + the shared `CredentialPort` +
> dispatch + OOP variant are one atomic feature (a per-provider split is
> artificial; 2,652 of the lines are corpus-bearing request-render test
> batteries), already green under real verification incl. both executed live
> legs (bash.0006 total). Fifth consecutive live-track overrun (+245% / +45% /
> ≈+470% / +144% / ≈+405%) — systematic under-pricing carried to GATE-G7.
> Recorded limitation: `request_ids`/`response_headers` are empty on the
> hosted-call legs — ADR-0363 D2 permits empty; enriching them needs a
> `LIVE_HEADERS`-style marker in the test harness — deferred as a follow-on
> note for the operator rather than growing this deviated ticket. Operator's
> merge gate on the PR is the decision point.
